notes: «- يعني ابن المغيرة -» is an editor's gloss, left out
Nasr's first-person visit: «أتينا اليشكري ... فذكر الحديث» makes al-Yashkuri the one asked who relates, so he is a link (rule 5/6)

The saying «قال قلت يا رسول الش» has Hudhayfa's words with no transmitter named for them; Hudhayfa is only the topic («حديث حذيفة»), so no Companion link is added: first-person narrative with implicit transmission (rule 11)
